description: List a store's carts (in-progress / abandoned checkouts). Returns a HAL collection embedding fx:carts. Foxy hAPI: GET /stores/{store_id}/carts.

store_id.description: Store id. If omitted, the default store (fx:store) is used.

zoom.description: Comma-separated related resources to embed, e.g. 'items,customer'.

name: foxy_list_carts
title: List carts
